# Frozen GitlabWorkSpace 0.24.2 predecessor

The installer comes from the committed v0.24.2 tag. The TAR.XZ contains the exact
manifest and payload of the official gitlab-workspace-kit-0.24.2.zip asset,
SHA-256 `278473854d7fbbc7cd2d4e255aee66510954282985949e5ddf63ef3741efbb6e`. Every archive entry was compared with the official ZIP.

Tests install both original profiles, upgrade to the current package and verify
that rollback restores the original installed bytes. No user data is included.
